name: CapillarityEngine
description: This engine loops over interactions with physics CapillaryPhysDelaunay and it assign pendular bridges to them. It is a reimplementation of (Scholtes2009b), adding the option of imposing the bridge volume (instead of only capillary pressure) and enabling using unstructured input data by...

attributes.name: binaryFusion
attributes.description: If true, capillary forces are set to zero as soon as, at least, 1 overlap (menisci fusion) is detected

attributes.name: capillaryPressure
attributes.description: Value of the capillary pressure Uc defines as Uc=Ugas-Uliquid

attributes.name: createDistantMeniscii
attributes.description: Generate meniscii between distant spheres? Else only maintain the existing one. For modeling a wetting path this flag should always be false. For a drying path it should be true for one step (initialization) then false, as in the logic of (Scholtes2009c). The engine turns it off automatically after one execution.

attributes.name: disp
attributes.description: Dispersion from the mean Value of the roughness

attributes.name: fusionDetection
attributes.description: If true potential menisci overlaps are checked

attributes.name: hertzOn
attributes.description: (auto-updated) true if hertz model is used

attributes.name: imposePressure
attributes.description: If True, suction is imposed and is constant if not Volume is imposed-Undrained test

attributes.name: inputFilename
attributes.description: the file with meniscus solutions, used for interpolation.

attributes.name: interactionDetectionFactor
attributes.description: defines critical distance for deleting interactions. Must be consistent with the Ig2 value.

attributes.name: liquidTension
attributes.description: Value of the superficial water tension in N/m

attributes.name: totalVolumeConstant
attributes.description: in undrained test there are 2 options, If True, the total volume of water is imposed,if false the volume of each meniscus is kept constant: in this case capillary pressure can be imposed for initial distribution of meniscus or it is the total volume that can be imposed initially

methods.name: intEnergy
methods.description: define the energy of interfaces in unsaturated pendular state

methods.name: solveStandalone
methods.description: Returns a CapillaryPhysDelaunay object representing a single bridge independently of the scene, using radii R1 and R2, capillary pressure, and gap between two spheres. The returned value contains internals of the interpolation process, it can be passed as an optional argument ('bridge'). If the resolution is repeated multiple times, re-using cached data will increase performance if the geometrical parameters are changing by small increments

methods.name: swInterface
methods.description: define the amount of solid-wetting interfaces in unsaturated pendular state

methods.name: waterVolume
methods.description: return the total value of water in the sample

methods.name: wnInterface
methods.description: define the amount of wetting-non-wetiing interfaces in unsaturated pendular state
